Dear [Mr Innes](/person/744)
I shall be glad to have fresh editions of [Beginnings of Christian History](/book/119) and of the [Pigeon Pie](/book/34).
My engineering [nephew](/person/1630) has routed up an atlas of Keith Johnstone of manageable size. If that does not prove sufficient I shall try [Cassell](/organisation/216)

Yours truly

C M Yonge
